content.text:
I found three codes for eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE).

| Code | Term | Include |
|---|---|---|
| J1017 | Eosinophilic oesophagitis | Yes |
| ^ESCTEO508265 | Eosinophilic esophagitis | Yes |
| ^ESCT1165474 | Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis | Yes |

I left out two related codes:
- **^ESCTEO508286, "Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus":** I wasn't sure it means the same thing as EoE. Add it if you want a broader list.
- **^ESCTEO620672, "Eosinophilic gastroenteritis":** this is a different condition.

I searched for "eosinophilic oesophagitis", "eosinophilic esophagitis", "eosinophilic oesophag", "eosinophilic esophag" and "eosinophilic gastro". I didn't run any other searches, such as a Read code search.
